mentions.name: Exhibit
mentions.description: A personal apps platform where an AI agent builds small apps for users, their friends, and family, which can be run on the platform or downloaded for portability with no lock-in. It enforces a deny-by-default security policy to contain untrusted AI-generated code, and is adding API connectors to bring in user data, with self-hosting supported today and a hosted version in progress.
mentions.problem: Interfaces today tend to start with a chatbot; the author wants a future of personal apps that don't.
mentions.audience: Individuals building small apps for themselves, friends, and family
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a personal apps platform! I still am hoping for a future where every interface doesn’t start with a chatbot.

https://github.com/momja/exhibit
mentions.author: dizzard
